item.tib: khams brgyad kyi zhun thig rnams dbye grangs su bkod pa
item.coloph: shang gi rme'u ston gyi/ khams brgyad don bkol 'di/ slob ma'i don ched du/ bla mas bton nas bkod/ gang gar bton 'gyur na/ ngo mtshar che rgyu med/ sprul sku lha yi lugs/ gsungs (gsung) rab khams brgyad do/ slob dpon jo sras te/ khro rgyal dngos la zhus/ slob ma'i don 'gyur shog/
